newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Holderbank bids for rest of HISALBA.
newsitem.headline: Holderbank bids for rest of HISALBA.

text.p: Holderbank Financiere Glaris Ltd said it plans to make a public bid of 1,600 pesetas per share to all minority shareholders of Spain's HISALBA (Hornos Ibericos Alba SA).
Holderbank, which currently owns more than 80 percent of HISALBA's capital, also said HISALBA will pay an interim dividend of 42 peseta per share.
The offer will be made through Holderbel SA, a Belgian financial holding company .
The public bid would be in an amount not exceeding approximately eight million peseta, Holderbank said.
HISALBA has five cement plants and is the fifth largest cement producer in Spain. It has an annual capacity of about four million tonnes of cement.
HISALBA had consolidated turnover of 38.6 billion peseta and a net profit of 3.7 billion in 1995. It currently employs 1,350 people, Holderbank said.
Trading in HISALBA was suspended in Madrid earlier today pending further information relevant to the share price.
